title: Zip of indexed sequences
statement: Let $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ be types, let $m$ be a natural number, let $f:\alpha\to\beta\to\gamma$, and let $a$ and $b$ be sequences indexed by $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ with values in $\alpha$ and $\beta$, respectively. Zipping their lists of values with $f$ gives the list whose $i$th entry is $f(a(i),b(i))$ for $0\le i<m$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps an $\alpha$ value and a $\beta$ value to a $\gamma$ value
